clip_faces: clip mesh faces against a frustum using ClipFrustum and clip_faces from pytorch3d renderer
convert_clipped_rasterization_to_origina: convert clipped rasterization outputs back to original unclipped face indices and barycentric coordinates
test_clip_faces_single_triangle_in_front: test clipping a single triangle fully in front of the image plane with no clipping applied
test_clip_faces_triangle_behind_plane: test clipping a single triangle fully behind the image plane which gets completely culled
test_rasterize_clipped_meshes_gradient_f: test gradient flow through mesh rendering when the camera is inside the mesh
